title: Knowledge Dependency Rules
description: Hard rules for declaring and validating dependencies between Knowledge Records. Specification only.

rules.statement: Hard Dependency targets MUST resolve to an existing or planned KR-* / approved asset ID before official release.
The directed graph of Hard Dependency and Inheritance edges MUST be acyclic.
A record MUST NOT declare a Hard Dependency on a downstream pack that itself hard-depends on the record (pack-level cycle).
Duplicate dependency declarations for the same (level, source, target) triple are forbidden.
Dependency level MUST be one of the registered levels in dependency_levels.json.
Soft Dependency SHOULD be upgraded to Hard Dependency when the target is required for canonical definition correctness.
Reference-level links MUST NOT be used to satisfy Hard Dependency publication gates.
Semantic Dependency SHOULD be documented explicitly when meaning presupposes another concept but load order is not blocking.
Extensions MUST name their base record; the base Canonical Definition remains authoritative.
record_id immutability is independent of dependency changes; remapping KR-* to fix dependencies is forbidden.
